outcome: Progression of fetal renal ectasia/hydronephrosis (measured by anteroposterior diameter of renal pelvis)
cohort: A male twin fetus diagnosed with left renal ectasia during prenatal ultrasound screening.
finding: The left renal pelvis anteroposterior diameter in the affected twin progressively increased from 4.5 mm at 20.1 weeks to 11.2 mm at 30.5 weeks of gestation, leading to a diagnosis of grade 3 hydronephrosis.
